title: Oracle Fusion Technical Consultant
summary: An Oracle Fusion technical consultant builds the reports, integrations (connections to other systems) and data loads around Oracle's cloud ERP and HR software, using tools such as BI Publisher, OTBI, OIC, FBDI and HDL. They work on implementation and support projects in consulting firms and company IT teams, alongside functional consultants who set up the business processes.
dailyDuties: Build BI Publisher and OTBI reports from requirements
Build and fix OIC integrations with other systems
Prepare and load data files with FBDI or HDL
Write SQL and PL/SQL for reports and conversions
Write technical design documents for each object
Fix failed integrations and data issues in live systems

skills.expectation: Know the Fusion ERP, HCM or SCM modules and their data well enough to build on them
Build BI Publisher and OTBI reports with data models and templates
Build OIC integrations with Fusion adapters, REST and SOAP
Convert and load legacy data with FBDI, HDL or ADFdi
Write SQL against Fusion tables for reports and checks
Write PL/SQL for report logic, conversions and validations
Call Fusion REST and SOAP services and map data with XSLT
Work with functional consultants and clients to agree technical designs
Build extensions with VBCS or APEX
Write technical design documents for each report and integration
Support live Fusion systems and fix failed integrations
Keep client teams updated during implementation projects

certifications.why: SQL basics that every Fusion technical role uses
Oracle Integration Cloud is asked for in nearly every Fusion technical posting.
